Here's Exactly What to Expect

One team and a clear plan at every step, from the first visit to the final walkthrough.

Step 01

We Come to You

A relaxed in-home walkthrough of your space, your goals, and how you live in your kitchen. We follow up as fast as we can with a cost range built around your real scope.

You get honest numbers tailored to your project, not a lowball guess.

Step 02

See It in 3D First

Walk through your new kitchen in photoreal 3D and choose every finish and fixture with our team, so nothing is left to chance. Hit play to see it in action.

You lock in the exact look before anything is built.

Step 03

Agreement & Schedule

A clear pre-construction agreement lays out the full scope, an itemized price for your selections, and a simple payment schedule. Change something later and you see the cost before we proceed.

You always know what you are paying for, with no surprise bills.

Step 04

Build & Complete

One in-house team, daily updates, and clean job sites, with honest communication if anything comes up along the way.

You get your finished kitchen, backed by a 5-year warranty.

Every kitchen is different, so we give you real timelines once we have seen your space, no guesswork.

FINANCING
Love your home now,

Most remodels are paid from savings, and we never push financing. But if monthly payments are easier for your family, two options are built right into your estimate, only if you want them.

Checking won’t affect your credit

You apply and repay directly with the lender. We do not offer financing ourselves and earn nothing from it, no kickbacks, no referral fees.

Two ways to finance

Both are independent marketplaces, connected right inside the tools we already use to run your project. Look into whichever fits, or neither.

HFS
HOME IMPROVEMENT LOAN MARKETPLACE

Matches you with a home improvement loan from its lending network, with no home equity, appraisal, or money down required. Fixed-rate loans funded directly to you, with longer repayment terms available.

Terms up to 20 years
No equity, appraisal, or money down
Funds paid directly to you

Best for larger projects.

Acorn Finance
LENDER MARKETPLACE

Connects you with a marketplace of 30+ lenders so you can compare personalized offers side by side and choose the monthly payment that fits. Prequalifying takes about two minutes.

Compare 30+ lenders at once
Prequalify in about two minutes
Funds as soon as the same day

Best for comparing offers fast.

A NOTE FROM WREEDONE

We do not offer financing ourselves, we get no kickback, referral fee, or commission, and there is no pressure from us. HFS and Acorn are simply options you can look into if you want to. Both are independent marketplaces, and any loan is arranged directly between you and the lender. The right choice is whatever is best for you and your family.

Financing questions

Will checking affect my credit score?

No. Prequalifying is a soft credit check, so it does not affect your score. You only move forward if you choose to.

What can I finance?
How long does it take?
Is there any obligation?
Do you make anything if I finance?
Who are HFS and Acorn?
WE ARE HERE TO HELP

The Highlands

This upscale neighborhood on the northwest side offers generous homesites and resort amenities. We personalize builder-grade kitchens with custom cabinetry, statement islands, and finishes that match the home's caliber.

Hogan's Glen

Trophy Club's gated luxury enclave is full of custom estates. These homes call for large, high-end kitchens with custom cabinetry, generous islands, and finishes worthy of the address.

Original Trophy Club

The town's original 1980s and 1990s neighborhoods are established brick traditionals hitting prime remodel age. We open up their closed-off kitchens into the bright, connected spaces homeowners want now.

The Golf Course

Homes lining Trophy Club's two 18-hole courses deserve kitchens that live up to the view, thoughtful layouts, statement islands, and finishes as considered as the setting.
